office: the Immigration Department (Ministry of Public Security)

routes.label: a damaged or lost passport replaced

note: The fee for a new passport, with or without a chip, 200,000 dong, and 400,000 for one replacing a passport damaged or lost (written as a replacement route), under Circular No. 28/2026/TT-BTC of 27 March 2026, in force from 1 April 2026 (art. 7), read on 2026-11-03 in the Official Gazette (Công báo No. 210 of 13 April 2026). Until 2026-11-03 the new passport's fee stood on the Ministry of Finance's journal, the circular unread, and the replacement wasn't written. The circular repeals Circulars 25/2021 and 62/2023 and gives no reduction; Circular 64/2025's 50% reduction, a lead until then, isn't named in it. Validity, the processing time and fees at missions abroad are leads.
